# Planned API outage - Wed Aug 7 9:00 - 11:00 pm PST

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Fareen** (8/6/2024):

Payment services will not be available between 9 pm - 11 pm PST on Wed August 7, 2024 due to a Pay API deployment. This will impact Registry Search API, PPR API and all API services requiring payment.
